Questions

What is the median annual wage for Web developers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual median for Web Developers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $96,870.

What is the hourly median for Web developers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 hourly median for Web Developers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $46.57.

How many Web developers work in Chicago?

OEWS May 2025 estimates 2,790 wage-and-salary Web Developers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN. Self-employed workers are excluded.

What is the location quotient for Web developers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 location quotient is 1.37. Values above 1.00 mean Web Developers are more concentrated in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN than in the national occupational mix.

What is the mean annual wage for Web developers in Chicago?

The OEWS May 2025 annual mean for Web Developers in Chicago-Naperville-Elgin, IL-IN is $101,800.

How does Chicago's Web developers median compare to the other WageGrid metros?

Chicago's published OEWS May 2025 annual median ($96,870) is $11,910 higher than Austin ($84,960) and $33,570 lower than Seattle ($130,440). These are published medians minus published medians. WageGrid does not adjust for cost of living.

Does this wage include self-employed workers?

No. OEWS estimates cover wage-and-salary workers and exclude the self-employed. WageGrid does not add a self-employment figure.

Why is a wage cell blank?

BLS withholds some OEWS estimates for quality or confidentiality. WageGrid does not fill those cells.
